<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to forming a sulfonamide from an aromatic amine and a phenylsulfonyl chloride (break S‑Cl, form N‑S). Using the search tool with these functional group criteria will retrieve the appropriate template ID, which we can then apply to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["N-S"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
